[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:386YE Autumn]]
__NOTOC__
<quote by="Proposed: Sarvos, Seconded: Spiral">To commission the construction of the Open Fan Cicisbeo Academy. A self funded money sinecure costing 10 white granite & 3 thrones 6 crowns in labour. It will provide income and create a title of "Headmistress of the Open Fan Academy" as appointed by senators of the League. This title has tenure and will be built in Cigno, Sarvos.</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[sinecure]] in Cigno, [[Sarvos]].
* Passed

==Date==
* Autumn 386YE

==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 10 white granite
* 30 crowns
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Open_Fan_Cicisbeo_Academy}}
==Outcome==
Now complete, the position of [[Headmistress of the Open Fan Academy]] will be available to appoint by unanimous vote of the senators of [[the League]] for the first time at the Winter Solstice 386YE
